subject: math
title: Length, mass, capacity and time facts

cards.front: How many centimetres are in 1 metre?
cards.say: How many centimetres are in one metre? One hundred centimetres.

cards.front: How many metres are in 1 kilometre?
cards.say: How many metres are in one kilometre? One thousand metres.

cards.front: How many grams are in 1 kilogram?
cards.say: How many grams are in one kilogram? One thousand grams.

cards.front: How many millilitres are in 1 litre?
cards.say: How many millilitres are in one litre? One thousand millilitres.

cards.front: Change 2 m to centimetres.
cards.say: Change two metres to centimetres. Two hundred centimetres. Two times one hundred equals two hundred.

cards.front: Change 500 cm to metres.
cards.say: Change five hundred centimetres to metres. Five metres. Five hundred divided by one hundred equals five.

cards.front: Change 2 kg to grams.
cards.say: Change two kilograms to grams. Two thousand grams

cards.front: Change 3,000 g to kilograms.
cards.say: Change three thousand grams to kilograms. Three kilograms

cards.front: Change 4 l to millilitres.
cards.say: Change four litres to millilitres. Four thousand millilitres

cards.front: Change 5,000 ml to litres.
cards.say: Change five thousand millilitres to litres. Five litres

cards.front: How many millilitres are in half a litre?
cards.say: How many millilitres are in half a litre? Five hundred millilitres

cards.front: How many grams are in half a kilogram?
cards.say: How many grams are in half a kilogram? Five hundred grams

cards.front: Which unit would you use for the length of a pencil: centimetres or kilometres?
cards.back:
Centimetres
A pencil is short, so centimetres fit best.
cards.say: Which unit would you use for the length of a pencil: centimetres or kilometres? Centimetres. A pencil is short, so centimetres fit best.

cards.front: Which unit would you use for the distance between two cities: metres or kilometres?
cards.back:
Kilometres
Long distances are measured in kilometres.
cards.say: Which unit would you use for the distance between two cities: metres or kilometres? Kilometres. Long distances are measured in kilometres.

cards.front: Which unit would you use for the mass of an apple: grams or kilograms?
cards.back:
Grams
An apple is light, so grams fit best.
cards.say: Which unit would you use for the mass of an apple: grams or kilograms? Grams. An apple is light, so grams fit best.

cards.front: How many seconds are in 1 minute?
cards.say: How many seconds are in one minute? Sixty seconds.

cards.front: How many minutes are in 1 hour?
cards.say: How many minutes are in one hour? Sixty minutes.

cards.front: How many minutes are in 2 hours?
cards.say: How many minutes are in two hours? One hundred and twenty minutes. Two times sixty equals one hundred and twenty.

cards.front: How many hours are in 1 day?
cards.say: How many hours are in one day? Twenty four hours.

cards.front: How many days are in 1 week?
cards.say: How many days are in one week? Seven days.

cards.front: How many months are in 1 year?
cards.say: How many months are in one year? Twelve months.

cards.front: How many days are in September?
cards.back: 30 days. April, June, September and November have 30.
cards.say: How many days are in September? Thirty days. April, June, September and November have thirty.

cards.front: What time is a quarter past 3?
cards.back:
3:15
A quarter of an hour is 15 minutes.
cards.say: What time is a quarter past three? Three fifteen. A quarter of an hour is fifteen minutes.

cards.front: What time is a quarter to 9?
cards.say: What time is a quarter to nine? Eight forty five. Fifteen minutes before nine o'clock.
